  though trucks and planes carry more goods than river boats do.

  Rivers deserve our respect and protection. They sustain life, shape the land,
  and connect communities. We must manage them carefully to balance human
  needs with the needs of the plants and animals that depend on them. Rivers
  will continue to flow long after we are gone, but only if we choose to
  preserve them.
